scientific_integrity: Uniform sign and asymptotic results are proved analytically; 256 finite numerical and algebraic checks are corroborative, not proof of the infinite quantifier. Older historical three-level literature could not all be read. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: At least two strict heat-capacity peaks for the stated three-level family; not an exact total peak count or an optimal cutoff. Assumes very large prescribed degeneracies, fixed energy gaps, equilibrium canonical ensemble, and no interactions. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Degeneracy-only splitting of Schottky peaks in an equally spaced three-level system
